citation: Gaesser GA, Rodriguez J, Patrie JT, et al. Effects of Glycemic Index and Cereal Fiber on Postprandial Endothelial Function, Glycemia, and Insulinemia in Healthy Adults. Nutrients. 2019;11(10):2387.
protocol: Four ~600 kcal breakfasts (~21 g protein, ~15 g fat) varying in fibre and GI (e.g. HF-LGI: 36 g All-Bran Buds, 20 g white bread, 19 g margarine, 44 g egg, 290 g nonfat milk, 175 g apple, 260 g apple juice); crossover. Blood before and hourly for 4 h.
population: 11 healthy adults (5 men, 6 women); age 42.4 ± 16.1 y; weight 70.5 ± 10.7 kg; USA (Virginia).

reports.where: Table 4: 1-h postprandial insulin by meal; Table 5: 4-h insulin AUC comparisons; Results text gives AUC mean ± SD per meal

note: Typical US breakfasts of fixed energy and protein, with foods listed to the gram; spans a middle-aged range. Sampling is hourly only, AUC is in µU/mL × hour, and Tables 4-5 are partly log-scale contrasts. Only in figures: hourly insulin time course. Meal kinds: mixed meal.
